A FEW SIMPLE GESTURES

Go with the flow.

Tap
Start, play again, or resume.
Hold still
Pause your game. Double-tap the paused screen to restart.
Swipe up / down
Next / previous game between rounds.
Swipe at the right edge
Switch games during play. You can also swipe with two fingers anywhere.
Swipe right
Open all games between rounds, or on the bottom title area during play.

Keyboard: Space to play · P to pause · N / B to browse
R to restart · G for games · ? for help
